newsitem.title: USA: Allstate in settlement with Mineral.
newsitem.headline: Allstate in settlement with Mineral.

text.p: Allstate Corp said it has reached a settlement with Mineral Acceptance Corp under which Mineral Acceptance, formerly known as Allstate Acceptance Corp, will no longer use the name Allstate.
The settlement came as a result of recent litigation brought by Allstate against Mineral Acceptance Corp concerning the Allstate name.
Allstate contended that Mineral Acceptance's use of the name Allstate was confusing to the public and infringed and diluted Allstate Insurance's trademarks.
Mineral Acceptance contended that it had been using "Allstate" as part of its corporate name for more than 25 years and denied any wrongdoing or liability.
Both parties agreed to settle to avoid the uncertainty and expense of protracted litigation.
Terms of the settlement were not disclosed.

Mineral Acceptance, originally incorporated in New Jersey in 1959, is a vertically integrated manufacturer, primarily engaged in mining, milling and refining from its own precious and strategic metal deposits.
